headlines.title: Mourinho keeps Clasico midas touch 13 years on as La Liga heats up
headlines.description: Kylian Mbappe's two goals at Barcelona have opened up La Liga, as Jose Mourinho's Real Madrid leave Camp Nou with a victory.

headlines.title: Arsenal relieve pressure with Spurs win - can they kick on now?
headlines.description: Arsenal end their five-match winless run in the Women's Super League with victory at Tottenham - but can they kick on now?

headlines.title: Should Palmer have been sent off earlier than he was?
headlines.description: Match of the Day pundit Martin Keown looks at the red card shown to Cole Palmer during Chelsea's 2-0 defeat to Tottenham, with the former Arsenal defender agreeing with the decision and suggesting Palmer was lucky not to receive a straight red for an early incident.
